# Canvas design (Anthropic)

Create original posters and static art as PNG or PDF, guided by a design philosophy.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/canvas-design/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/canvas-design-anthropic-c8deeaea

Has Claude first write a short design philosophy for the piece and then render it as a polished static image or PDF, such as a poster, cover or art print. It stresses original work rather than imitating living artists, careful composition and minimal text. A large bundle of open-licensed fonts is included so typography renders properly. Output is produced with Python drawing libraries.

**Try asking:**
- "Design a minimalist poster for our jazz night on June 14"
- "Make a PDF art print inspired by tide charts"
- "Create a cover image for my quarterly report"
